body:
Benchmark replica of #23 (OVP-T3-10), solved on benchmark/base-t3-10

### Description
Add a string-based user identifier to tasks and implement a query filter on the `GET /api/todos` endpoint to enable a "My Tasks" view without full authentication.

### Scope
- Add `userId` (string) to `TodoItem` entity, DTOs, and creation/update contracts.
- Update `GET /api/todos` to accept an optional `userId` query parameter alongside the existing `isCompleted` filter.
- Update endpoint documentation in `docs/OpenAPI.md`.
- Add unit and integration tests for user tagging and filtered queries.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tasks can be created with and tagged by a `userId` string.
- [ ] `GET /api/todos?userId={userId}` returns only tasks belonging to the given user.
- [ ] Combining `userId` and `isCompleted` filters works correctly.
- [ ] Backwards compatibility is preserved for tasks without a specified `userId`.
- [ ] `docs/OpenAPI.md` is updated to reflect new parameters.
- [ ] Automated tests cover the new user field and filtering behavior.
title: [Benchmark] Add user identification to tasks and "My Tasks" filtering
